:::{#thm-mutual-information-chain-rule}
#### Chain rule for mutual information

For [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$, $Y$ and $Z$
whose [entropies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) $\entropyf{X}$, $\entropyf{Y}$ and $\entropyf{Z}$ are finite,

$$I(X, Z; Y) = I(Z; Y) + I(X; Y \mid Z).$$

:::

::: {.proof}

By @thm-mutual-information-reduction, applied to the pair $(X, Z)$ and to $Z$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
I(X, Z; Y) &= \entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X, Z} \\
I(Z; Y) &= \entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid Z}.
\end{aligned}
$$

Subtracting the second display from the first gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
I(X, Z; Y) - I(Z; Y)
&= \entropyf{Y \mid Z} - \entropyf{Y \mid X, Z} \\
&= I(X; Y \mid Z),
\end{aligned}
$$

where the last line is @def-conditional-mutual-information.

:::
